title: Google's Energy Chief Warns Orbital Data Centers Are 100 Times More Expensive Than Earth Sites

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Google's head of data center energy advised technology companies to prioritize terrestrial infrastructure and maximize their options on the ground before attempting to build computing facilities in space. The recommendation comes as Google carries out its own experiments by testing AI chips in orbit, though the executive warned that the expense of launching computing hardware can be as much as 100 times higher than constructing equivalent sites on land.

The cost estimate differs from optimistic projections by space industry analysts and the strategy pursued by SpaceX for its orbital data centers. While Google's energy chief stated that the US power supply is sufficient to sustain data center growth, she noted that slow permitting processes continue to hinder terrestrial expansion.
